newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African state spending head to leave at year-end.
newsitem.headline: S.African state spending head to leave at year-end.

text.p: South African director-general of state expenditure Hannes Smit would leave the department at the end of the year as planned, despite requests that he stay on, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.
"Despite requests to stay on in his position, he has reaffirmed his decision, made when he took the contract, not to accept a second term," the Ministry said in a statement.
Smit would serve out the remainder of his term heading up the proposed Expenditure Evaluation Unit and would remain director-general until a new person was appointed.
The Ministry said the post would be advertised next week.
